mcpTools.name: candle_query
mcpTools.summary: 查询单只证券的原始 OHLCV/K 线数据（日/周/月/分钟）；已有标准指标时优先使用 indicator_query
mcpTools.description:
Get raw OHLCV K-line (candlestick) data for one security. Securities market+code MUST come from search_securities.
Returns: { "USHA600519": [{ time: UnixSec, "11": close, "7": open, "8": high, "9": low, ... }] }
Fields: 1=时间（Unix秒） 7=开盘 8=最高 9=最低 11=收盘 13=总量（成交量） 19=成交额.
For standard technical indicators already supported by indicator_query (MA, EMA, MACD, RSI, BOLL, ATR, KDJ, and similar), use indicator_query first and avoid calculating or manually deriving them from these candles. Fall back to raw-candle calculation only when the standard capability is unavailable or the user explicitly requests a custom calculation.
Do NOT use for historical TopN/extreme-day ranking (e.g. 历史涨幅最大的几天); use wencai_query hithink-market-query instead to avoid bulk K-line fetch + local sorting.

market.description: Market code from search_securities result, e.g. "USHA", "USZA", "USBA". NEVER guess — always from search_securities.

code.description: Security code from search_securities result, e.g. "600519". NEVER guess.

securities.description: Exactly one security to query. market+code from search_securities.

period.description: K-line period: 5=日K 11=周K 12=月K 15=1分 16=5分 17=15分 18=30分 19=60分

adjustType.description: Price adjustment: 0=不复权 1=前复权 2=后复权

offset.description: Number of bars from the end (e.g. 60 = last 60 bars)

timeRange.description: Time range. Use { offset: 60, toLatest: true } for last 60 bars, or { beginTime, endTime } for absolute range

mcpTools.name: client_exec_script
mcpTools.summary: 在受限沙箱里执行客户端编排脚本（多步取数/操作的自定义组合）
mcpTools.description: 执行 JavaScript 客户端操作流程，支持页面就绪检查、分支和循环。基本 helper：clientCall(name,argsObj)、dataCall(name,argsObj)、searchSecurities(args)、realtimeQuery(args)；params 为脚本入参。命名和模式限制见指南。使用本工具前，必须通过 read_doc({"tools":["client-script-guide"]}) 完整阅读编写指南，并遵循其中的案例选择和执行规则。当前会话已完整读取且仍适用时，无需重复读取。该标识为文档 ID，不是本地路径；读取失败时先解决文档访问问题，不跳过指南直接执行。提交 script + params；交互式任务最多等待 6 秒，未完成返回 running + executionId。收到 running 后用本工具仅传 executionId 查询原执行，直到终态，不重复提交脚本。提交和查询均可选 waitMs（0–6000 整数，默认 6000）；0 立即返回状态，不取消脚本。completed 仅表示脚本返回，不代表业务成功。

executionId.description: 查询已有执行；不重新提交 script

waitMs.description: 提交或查询时使用，默认等待 6000ms；0 立即返回状态，不取消脚本

mcpTools.name: http_get
mcpTools.summary: 经管道桥接的通用 HTTP GET（DataHub、涨跌分布等场景，须先读对应契约）
mcpTools.description:
Generic HTTP GET proxied through the named pipe bridge. Used for documented GET APIs including DataHub and rise/fall distribution statistics (涨跌分布统计、上涨/下跌家数分布、红绿盘结构).
Guardrail for DataHub: first load the datahub-lumi Skill and read the target snapshot contract. Use only published GET endpoints and do not read or manually set Cookie headers.
Guardrail for rise/fall distribution: first call read_doc with data-apis/reference/rise-fall-statistics and follow that doc exactly. If you have not read that doc in this turn, do NOT call http_get for this scenario and do NOT guess URL parameters from memory or examples.
Rise/fall URL: https://apigate.10jqka.com.cn/d/platform/marketinfo/overview/distribution/v3?date=YYYYMMDD

Forwards to the client-side pipe server (HttpPostAsync) which performs the actual HTTP POST.
Use for endpoints that require a POST body (JSON-RPC, form submit, upstream APIs that only accept POST).
Same pipe as http_get: requires the app to be launched with --pipe-name; otherwise pipeGuard blocks it.

mcpTools.name: indicator_query
mcpTools.summary: 服务端计算常用标准技术指标并返回结构化结果，不操作当前图表；已有 K 线时也应优先使用本工具，避免 Agent 手工重算
mcpTools.description: Calculate common technical indicators on the server and return structured values. Use this for MA, EMA, MACD, RSI, KDJ, BOLL, ATR, OBV, volume MA, volume ratio, and amplitude. latest returns only the newest value; series returns a bounded sequence. Uses a fixed 750-bar finite replay; history reports warmup coverage before the first output. Insufficient warmup may affect recursive values. OBV is relative to history.startTime, not an all-history total. This tool is read-only and never applies indicators to the chart. Use generateIndicator for chart application.

mcpTools.name: wencai_query
mcpTools.summary: 问财结构化查询（21 个 skill：财务、行情筛选、宏观、基金、选股等）
mcpTools.description:
Query 同花顺问财 OpenAPI /v1/query2data (21 skills, structured tabular data).
Returns { datas: [...], columns: [...], row_count, status_code }. Use datas[] only — query/chunks_info are GBK garbage.
Use for market-wide screening/count queries (有多少股票满足X、筛出X、涨幅大于昨天跌幅、放量突破、连涨等); do not emulate these by fetching realtime/candle data for the whole market.
Use for single-security historical TopN/extreme-day queries (历史涨幅最大的几天、跌幅最大、成交量/振幅/换手率最高日期); prefer this over bulk candle_query + local sorting.
Pick skillId by topic:
  finance / business / event / management / market / industry / zhishu(指数) / macro / fund / futures / basicinfo / insresearch(研报评级 + ESG)
  + selector类: sector / cb(可转债) / etf / fund / fundcompany / fundmanager / hkstock / usstock / futures
Query language: standardized Chinese financial terms ("600519.SH 2025三季度ROE")，not colloquial ("茅台赚了多少").
For single-stock/company questions, pass the stock/company name directly with the metric/event when known (e.g. "浦发银行 2025三季度ROE"), without first resolving or inventing a security code.
Auth + headers + trace-id auto-handled. UTF-8 throughout.

query.description: Standardized query in Chinese financial terms

realtime.说明: 质押式回购实际占款天数
未撮合成交量/早盘未匹配量
买入委托成交最大等待时间
